predecessors.name: Republic of China
predecessors.text: the realms of Yan Xishan (Shanxi), Feng Yuxiang ('the provinces of Gansu, Shaanxi and Henan') and the Guangxi clique's home province, Guangxi.

successors.name: Republic of China
successors.text: the coalition's land after the resignations of 4 November 1930

ledger.x: 1930: Yan Xishan takes the lead of the anti-Chiang coalition.
11 May 1930: Chiang's Central Army opens the general offensive.
Before 25 June 1930: the Guangxi Army takes Yueyang.
25 June 1930: the Shanxi Army takes Jinan.
Before 15 August 1930: the Guangxi Army is cut off and forced home.
Late September 1930: Zhang Xueliang takes Peking.

wars.name: Central Plains War
wars.outcome: Nationalist government victory: Yan Xishan and Feng Yuxiang resigned on 4 November 1930 and the Beiping government fell once Zhang Xueliang's Northeast Army declared for Chiang (18 September) and took Peking.

certainty.note: Provincial lines of the cliques' realms, not survey borders; the fronts (Kaifeng, Jinan, Yueyang) moved month by month and the page gives no boundary.
